conviction_note: A slight negative lean (p_up 45) on a large scale (abs 9%). The only published Q3 consensus (NOK 525m revenue, EBIT 40m, EBITDA about 58m, cited by Redeye) looks high once you account for a NOK that is about 9% stronger against the EUR than a year ago and a loss-making emporia consolidated for the first time. Against that, Nordea raised its estimates on 3 Nov, and 2.48% of the stock is disclosed short (about 12 days of volume, which the baseline missed), so a print that is merely not bad can squeeze. The findings sum to -0.7 against a scaled -0.9; they agree in sign and the bar is a single source, so neither number is large.

already_public.what: Q3 subscription base: 552k at 30 Sep 2026 (+109k y/y, +10k m/m in September), so the subscription KPI for the quarter is pre-released
Q3 subscription path: 542k at 31 Aug, 42k gross adds in August (an all-time high), net +23k
October (Q4) subscriptions: 546k, a -6k net change m/m, 14k gross adds. Nordea called it 'weaker than usual'

Q3 will carry a NOK 16m financial loss from settling the Careium hybrid loan, plus the first consolidation of emporia (H1 pro forma revenue NOK 78.2m, loss NOK 24.0m). Outlook: 'continued subscription growth and service revenue in the third quarter'
No profit warning (resultatvarsel) and no inside-information release since the Q2 report; the only items are an EGM, a new chair, a buy-back and the monthly subscription updates

new_in_release.expect: Revenue and EBITDA for Q3, including Senior device volumes (consensus 313k, Redeye 265k) and emporia's first quarter. Expect revenue a little below the cited NOK 525m consensus because of FX translation and the tough 2025 Senior comparison. EBITDA direction is uncertain (Redeye 45m, Nordea raised).

The Doro Connect retail rollout: store count (Redeye says 130 Norwegian Power stores) and the first Senior subscription numbers. This was the line that broke the stock after Q2. Expect modest progress; direction unknown.
Q4 commentary after a weak October in subscriptions (-6k). Expect cautious wording; leans negative.

The company gives no numeric guidance and the qualitative outlook is likely to be repeated. The uplisting decision (committed in Nov 2025 to be completed within 12 months) may be addressed, probably as a delay given the share price. Unknown.
Working capital and inventory (NOK 367m at Q2) plus the emporia debt taken on. Net interest-bearing debt was NOK 453m at Q2 and will rise with emporia. Leans negative.

bar: Q3 2026 consensus: net sales NOK 525m, EBIT NOK 40m, EBITDA about NOK 58m (derived from Redeye's NOK 45m being '22% below consensus'), Senior phones 313k. Single source: Redeye's preview of 2026-11-05 (https://borsvarlden.com/finwire/CRF00FC258), which sits below it at 494m / EBIT 30m. Nordea raised its 2026-28E EBITDA by 24-41% on 2026-11-03 (https://www.borsvarlden.com/finwire/CRF00FB40F) without published Q3 figures. No two estimate sources agree, so the bar is disputed and every size is capped small.

findings.finding: The NOK strengthened sharply year on year in Q3 2026: EURNOK about 10.27-10.88 against 11.63-11.75 in Q3 2025 (about -9%), SEKNOK -10%, GBPNOK -7%. Most of Xplora's device and service revenue is invoiced in EUR, SEK and GBP, and the company itself said FX hurt service revenue in Q2 when the move was smaller. So reported NOK revenue faces a larger translation headwind than in Q2, and the NOK 525m consensus may not fully reflect it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 26: revenue 9% below Bloomberg consensus (per Nordea), and the stock fell 31% on the day, with the Doro Connect delay also in that release.
findings.why_not_priced: Redeye cut its sales estimate 'on FX and Doro mix' to 494m, but the consensus it cites still sits at 525m, so at least part of the bar has not absorbed it. If it had, consensus would sit near Redeye's number. Macro-to-company transmission, partly confirmed by the company's own Q2 statement ('less favourable exchange rate movements negatively impacted service revenue', Q2 report p.8).
findings.independence: Redeye's preview independently cut sales on FX: https://borsvarlden.com/finwire/CRF00FC258

findings.finding: Redeye's Q3 preview puts EBITDA at NOK 45m, 22% below consensus, EBIT at 30m against 40m, sales at 494m against 525m, and Senior phones at 265k against a 313k consensus (215k Doro + 50k emporia). On this view the bar is set too high on Senior volumes.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Senior device volumes are the line that broke Q2 (Senior revenue -20% to NOK 198m, Senior volumes -17% y/y, stock -31%).
findings.why_not_priced: It is a published broker estimate and therefore partly priced. Its value is that it shows a single consensus figure that has not converged on the post-Q2 reality, which appears to rest on stale or optimistic estimates. Partly offset by Nordea's upgrade, filed separately. Capped small because the bar is disputed.
findings.independence: ABG (2026-09-02) says the market 'extrapolated the strong 2025 performance' in Senior and that 2G-sunset volumes are fading: https://borsvarlden.com/finwire/CRF00EBEB7

findings.finding: Nordea raised its 2026E-28E EBITDA by 24-41% on 3 Nov 2026, saying its post-Q2 estimates were too pessimistic on Senior profitability. It now expects Senior device sales to recover, takes a brighter view of emporia, and raised its fair value to NOK 41-56 (from 38-55), against a spot of 24.2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock rose from 23.3 (2 Nov) to 25.5 (4 Nov) around the note, then gave it back on the October subscription update.
findings.why_not_priced: Already partly reflected in the 4 Nov bounce, which reversed. It stands as the counterweight to Redeye: two of the four covering brokers disagree on the direction of Q3 Senior profitability.

findings.finding: Q4 opened weak: the October subscription base fell 6k m/m to 546k, against +3k in October 2025 (443k -> 446k). Nordea called it 'weaker than usual, for a seasonally weak month' and expects 'little-to-slight-downward revisions' to its Q4 base of 578k.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell 3.7% on 2026-11-06, the day of the update (24.25 -> 23.35).
findings.why_not_priced: Public, and the stock already fell on it. What is not priced is management's explanation (churn of Q3 back-to-school SIMs, or structural), which only the release and call carry. Sized near zero for that reason.
findings.independence: Nordea's note on the update: https://www.inderes.dk/en/third-party-research/xplora-technologies-monthly-subscriptions-update-october-2026-nordea; October 2025 comparison: https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=659012

findings.finding: The disclosed net short is 2.48% (Citadel 0.88, Two Sigma 0.90, Liontrust 0.70; 1.19m shares, about 12 days of average volume), built from 1.50% in mid-September. The sealed baseline reads it as 0.0 because of a name-join miss. In a $224k/day stock, a print that is not a disaster leaves systematic shorts as covering fuel.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Shorts built into the Q2 crash (1.20% on 7 Aug to 2.69% on 21 Aug) and had no visible effect on that day's reaction. No squeeze observed on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The register is public, but the stage's own baseline missed it, so priced_lean_pct carries no short component. The holders are mostly quant funds, whose positions are not a fundamental view. If the market had priced a squeeze, the stock would not sit at its post-Q2 low, under the 26.07 average buy-back price.
findings.independence: E24, 2026-09-05: 'Hedgefondet er en gjenganger på Oslo Børs, og sitter i dag med flere shortposisjoner, blant annet i Höegh Autoliners, Norbit og Xplora.' https://e24.no/boers-og-finans/i/OkXeGb/bitter-skilsmisse-kan-koste-eierskap-i-hedgefondet

findings.finding: Q3 carries a pre-disclosed NOK 16m (SEK 16m) financial loss from settling the Careium hybrid loan. It sits below operating income, was announced in the Q2 report's post-quarter note and has no path to the guide.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: disclosed in August. Filed for completeness so that a below-the-line loss in the release is not read as news.

findings.finding: emporia is consolidated for the first time in Q3. It is loss-making: H1 2026 pro forma revenue NOK 78.2m and loss NOK 24.0m, with sales held back by liquidity constraints and one-offs. Xplora also took on its debt (NOK 116m interest-bearing at fair value) and paid NOK 61.9m to settle an external loan at closing. The NOK 50m synergies only arrive 'gradually during 2027'. So Q3 group EBITDA margin and net debt both take a hit that a top-line beat could hide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior consolidation quarter. The Doro consolidation in Q1 25 was greeted +3.98%.
findings.why_not_priced: Redeye says the first emporia quarter 'makes forecasting harder', so estimates are dispersed. Nordea's brighter emporia view points the other way. Net of the rest of the company, emporia is about 10% of quarterly revenue, so the effect is capped.

findings.finding: Doro Connect is now live in 130 Norwegian Power stores, per Redeye's preview. That is a concrete store count against the one pilot store at Q2, on the rollout whose third delay caused the Q2 collapse, and the release is where the first Senior subscription conversion number would appear.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 26: the rollout delay (900 stores guided at the CMD, then one pilot) was named by Redeye and ABG as the reason for the -31% day.
findings.why_not_priced: Neither the company nor Power has announced the store count on NewsWeb, so it rests on one broker line. If the market had priced proof of the rollout, the stock would have recovered above the post-Q2 range (23.5-25) rather than sitting in it.
findings.independence: ABG (2026-09-02): rollout to about 135 Norwegian Power stores starting in September: https://borsvarlden.com/finwire/CRF00EBEB7

findings.finding: The company's own Q2 report says Senior unit sales were boosted 'in Q2 25 and throughout the second half of 2025' by the Aurora launch and the 2G/3G-to-4G shift, against Q3 25 group revenue of NOK 510m and EBITDA of NOK 72m. Q3 26 therefore laps the toughest Senior comparison of the year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 26, the first quarter lapping it, fell 31%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the company flagged it and brokers cut after Q2. What remains is a y/y headline revenue decline that the release headline will carry, on a name that has fallen 58% year to date.

outside_window.finding: Board decision on uplisting from Euronext Growth to Oslo Børs or Nasdaq Stockholm, committed in Nov 2025 to be completed 'within 12 months', which runs to about 2026-11-26. It may be addressed in the release, but the deadline itself falls after the window.
NOK 50m annual cost synergies from Doro + emporia, with effect gradually during 2027

baseline_tension: The baseline's lean (-0.49, run-up only) agrees with my slight negative, but the baseline misses a 2.48% short built into the print. That positioning cuts against the negatives, so the negatives stay small and p_up sits at 45, not lower.
language_note: E24 (Norwegian, 2026-09-05) named Two Sigma as short Xplora ('sitter i dag med flere shortposisjoner, blant annet i ... Xplora'). That led me to the SSR register and exposed the baseline's 0.0 as a name-join miss. The register itself is language-neutral.

Otherwise nothing the English sources did not already carry: every issuer release is in English on NewsWeb, and the broker notes (Redeye, Nordea, ABG) are English via Finwire and Inderes. Finansavisen was unreachable.
lessons_applied: 'A number the market has already been told is worth 0': October subscriptions -0.5 -> -0.2 (public, the stock fell on it); Careium loss -0.1 -> 0.0 (disclosed in August); tough-comparison finding -0.3 -> -0.2 (company-flagged).
'Positioning is the thing to beat': my negatives agree with a short that built into the print, so FX -0.8 -> -0.6, Redeye -0.7 -> -0.6, emporia -0.5 -> -0.4.

'You were right about the number and too small about the move': abs_move_pct 8 -> 9, because these are new numbers on a thin name whose last two prints moved -9.6% and -31%. p_up 44 -> 45, since the bar is a single disputed source.
'`short_ratio_pct: 0.0` ... is not a measurement': verified the register directly and found 2.48%, so positioning_check corrects the baseline.
